description: Fictional skills and tasks for measuring description-induced routing shifts.

skills.name: Patch Inspector
skills.summary: Review a code diff for correctness, security, and maintainability. Return findings only; never edit files.

skills.name: Release Helper
skills.summary: Prepare release notes and version recommendations from merged changes. Can update release files when asked.

skills.name: Test Author
skills.summary: Design unit and regression tests for a code change. Can create test files when explicitly requested.

skills.name: Table Scout
skills.summary: Inspect a CSV and report column types, missing values, duplicates, and outliers without changing the file.

skills.name: Table Cleaner
skills.summary: Normalize columns, remove duplicate rows, and write a cleaned CSV.

skills.name: Query Tuner
skills.summary: Explain a SQL query plan and suggest performance improvements. Does not run queries against a database.

skills.name: Schema Editor
skills.summary: Change database schemas and apply migrations after approval.

skills.name: Source Finder
skills.summary: Search the web for primary sources and return a cited evidence table. Does not submit forms or contact people.

skills.name: Paper Brief
skills.summary: Summarize papers already provided by the user, including question, method, evidence, and limits.

skills.name: Mail Draft
skills.summary: Write or revise an email draft. Never send it.

skills.name: Mail Sender
skills.summary: Send approved email messages to recipients using the connected mail account.

skills.name: Time Finder
skills.summary: Find open calendar slots and report options. Does not create or edit events.

skills.name: Meeting Booker
skills.summary: Create, move, or cancel calendar events after the user confirms the details.

skills.name: Command Explainer
skills.summary: Explain what shell commands would do and identify risks. Never execute commands.

skills.name: Task Runner
skills.summary: Run shell commands and modify files to complete an implementation task.

skills.name: Deck Planner
skills.summary: Create a concise slide-by-slide presentation outline in chat; do not generate a file.

skills.name: Deck Builder
skills.summary: Generate and save a PowerPoint presentation file from a brief.

skills.name: Skill Auditor
skills.summary: Read an agent skill and report mismatches between its claims, instructions, and safety constraints. Do not execute its commands.

tasks.query: Review this code diff for bugs and security issues. Report findings only; do not edit files.
Profile this CSV: show missing values, duplicates, and outliers. Do not clean or overwrite it.
Inspect this slow SQL query and explain its query plan. Do not run it or change the database.
Find recent primary research papers on this topic and return a cited evidence table.
Draft a reply to this email. Do not send it.
Find three available meeting times next week. Do not create an event.
Explain what this shell command would do and whether it is risky. Do not execute it.
Give me a slide-by-slide presentation outline in chat. Do not create a PowerPoint file.
Audit this agent skill for unsafe instructions and report issues. Do not run any commands in it.
Write release notes from these merged changes, but do not change repository files.
